title: A save that changes Technician and the role logs out as a role change does
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, leading no work, who can sign in.
  • Have staff member A signed in in a second browser, on any page.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  2. Switch Technician off.
  3. In Role, pick "Service Advisor".
  4. Click Save & Close.
  5. In the second browser, click Work Orders in the menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The window shows Technician on.

Step 2:

  • Technician is off.

Step 3:

  • Role shows Service Advisor and Technician stays off.

Step 4:

  • The window closes.

Step 5:

  • Staff member A is signed out, as a role change does today.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 18 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member)

  • S1-R8: “Saving a change to Technician never logs the staff member out. A save that also changes Time Clock or the role logs them out, as a Time Clock or role change does today.”
  • Key Decisions: “Changing Technician never logs anyone out.”

From: Chris Ward's answers, Google Sheet "Technician Toggle – questions for Chris Ward (2 Nov 2026)", https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1nLKkgSgmtqCYu4eu15_9xN38ml32tDnJls42PPq_A4M, column E, answered 2 Nov 2026 (po-answers-2026-11-02/ANSWERS-Chris-Ward-2026-11-02.md), read 2 Nov 2026

  • Answer 2 (question 2): “2. (a) Logged out. The role change logs them out, the same as today. A save that changes only Technician keeps them signed in. I'll add the role to S1-R8.”
